far_v2/seed0.allocation_rule: the equal share per stratum, capped by each stratum's population, with the surplus handed one at a time to the smallest stratum that still has room
far_v2/seed0.join_on: instance_ids. split_indices are positions in the split as the task's loader returns it, BEFORE the dataset class filters it — DeceptionDatasetLlama drops any record whose target or distractor is not a single token — so on a split that is not already prefiltered they do not index the dataset the causal analyses iterate. The ids always do.
